operators.customDisplayName: Load water body testing data from 2013. File: data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_water_testing) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_water_testing
    
    # Count total samples
    total_samples = len(df)
    
    # Count samples with violations (exceeded bacterial standards)
    violation_samples = len(df[df['Violation'] == 'yes'])
    
    # Calculate percentage to 3 decimal places
    percentage = (violation_samples / total_samples) * 100
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'Total Samples': [total_samples],
        'Violation Samples': [violation_samples],
        'Percentage': [round(percentage, 3)]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate percentage of water samples with violations (exceeded bacterial standards). Total samples vs violation samples, percentage rounded to 3 decimal places.
